column1: Melt the butter and let it cool slightly.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In a second bowl whisk the eggs, buttermilk and vanilla, then whisk in the melted butter.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry and gently whisk just until no dry flour remains. Small lumps are fine. Let the thick batter rest while the pan heats.
Heat a griddle or large skillet over medium heat and grease it well with butter or nonstick spray.
Pour a heaping 1/4 cup of batter per pancake and cook about 2 minutes until the edges set and holes appear around the border.
Flip and cook 1–2 minutes more until cooked through, greasing the pan between batches as needed.
Hold finished pancakes in a 200°F (93°C) oven until all are cooked, then serve with toppings.
